purpose: DCA (walk-forward split) and quarterly grid validation; not evidence of future returns
dataset: Binance USDT-M futures 1h, 2023-10-01..2026-10-01, BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP (same data as emacross-grid-2023-2026.json); futures used as a proxy for spot
excluded: BTCUSDT: DCA 50 USDT and grid 40 USDT per level are below the futures minimum (step 0.001 BTC, min notional 50), so no orders were placed

assumptions.risk: risk.DefaultConfig (kill switch 5% daily loss / 20% drawdown, close on kill)
assumptions.fills: 1h OHLC; grid limit fills without queue position (optimistic)

dca.params: buy 50 USDT every 24h, max 10 buys, leverage 1, split 50%: IS 2023-10..2025-04, OOS 2025-04..2026-10

grid.params: re-armed each quarter: geometric 20 levels within ±15% of the quarter open, 40 USDT per level, stop 3% below the range
